messages:
olivia: trying the quickstart curl example and hitting two things at once.
olivia: curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/firstcall -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -> x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
olivia: also the response body (when I bypass TLS) is {"error":"workspace_pending_billing","message":"workspace needs billing setup"} even though my Console shows a card on file.
samir: usually those are unrelated: TLS stack vs workspace state. For the TLS error, is this a corp proxy with a private CA? Can you paste the `curl -v` snippet (redact keys)?
olivia: output:
```
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* subject: CN=corp-proxy.local
* issuer: CN=Corp Internal CA
* SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain
```
olivia: if I run `curl --insecure` the request reaches the API and returns the workspace_pending_billing JSON.
ajohnson: workspace_pending_billing = valid credentials but workspace not activated/fully billed. Could be a different org token or the trial wasn't activated.
jake: check the token->org mapping: run:
```
curl https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/whoami -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"
```
jake: the quickstart picks up whatever env var or local secret you have. People often copy a personal token that points to a different org.
olivia: whoami returned org_id: org_zz9x but Console is showing org_11aa. Oh neat, I grabbed the wrong token from my clipboard.
samir: that explains billing mismatch. For the cert, options: add the internal CA to your system truststore, use REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE for python, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS for node, or run the quickstart in a container that trusts the CA. Example: `export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/corp-ca.pem`.
olivia: changed to the correct org token and set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE; quickstart now completes successfully. thanks!
infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI job ci/quickstart-run for olivia failed at 2146789800 with TLS error; auto-retried once.
devex-bot: suggestion: add a small troubleshooting section in quickstart titled "Corporate proxies & wrong-token gotchas" and include a `whoami` first-step. Also surface a clearer error when token org doesn't match dashboard org.
olivia: opening a tiny GH issue and will PR a docs patch. proposing the whoami snippet be the first command in the quickstart.
ajohnson: please tag @samir on the issue. also maybe surface an inline assertion in SDKs: if whoami.org_id != dashboard.selected_org then warn with a link to billing docs.
olivia: will do, thanks :raised_hands: saved my afternoon!
